items.exampleEn: This small boat has an engine at the back.

items.exampleEn: The ad was so funny that everyone talked about it.

items.exampleEn: The red color emphasizes the most important words.
items.exampleZh: 紅色突顯出最重要的字。

items.exampleEn: The phone signal is weak in the mountains.
The film has amazing visual effects.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影有很驚人的視覺效果。

items.exampleEn: The letter informed us that the shop was closing.
items.exampleZh: 信上通知我們那家店要關了。

items.exampleEn: Entry to the park is through the north gate.

items.sentenceEn: The engine stopped in the middle of the road.

items.audioEn: Please inform the front desk if your room key stops working.
items.audioZh: 如果房卡不能用了，請通知櫃台。
items.questionZh: 房卡不能用時要怎麼做？
options: Call the manager's office at once.

items.sentenceEn: Wait for the signal before you start running.
This book has many visual examples.
items.sentenceZh: 這本書有很多圖像範例。

items.stemEn: Turn left when you see the traffic ____.
Our teacher ____ the importance of reading every day.
items.stemZh: 老師強調每天閱讀的重要性。

items.passageEn: In our business class, we studied how to make a good ad. Our teacher emphasized that visual images often work better than long texts. She showed us old ads made with simple computer graphics, and a car ad with a shining engine. For a class assignment, each team made an ad for a small device that sends a signal to your phone when you lose your keys. The ad also had to inform people about the price. Our team's entry won the class contest!
items.passageZh: 我們的商業課學習怎麼做出好的廣告。老師強調，視覺圖像常常比長篇文字更有效。她給我們看用簡單電腦圖像做的老廣告，還有一則引擎閃閃發亮的汽車廣告。課堂作業是每一隊替一個小裝置做廣告，這個裝置在你弄丟鑰匙時會傳送訊號到你的手機。廣告也必須告訴大家價格。我們這隊的作品贏得了班上的比賽！

options: 廣告一定要有好聽的音樂
廣告越長越能吸引客人

questions.questionZh: 作者那一隊的作品怎麼了？

items.promptZh: 這個裝置可以把照片傳到電腦。
referenceEn: This device can send photos to the computer.
The device can send pictures to your computer.
rubricZh: device 表示「裝置、設備」，可數名詞，例如 this device 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式，如 can send 等）

items.promptZh: 我在報紙上登了一則廣告，想賣掉我的舊車。
referenceEn: I put an ad in the newspaper to sell my old car.
I placed an ad in the paper because I want to sell my old car.
rubricZh: 用 ad 表示「廣告」（寫 advertisement 也正確）
